title: The Erlenmeyer Flask
source_sentence: The tagline for this episode is "Trust No One", which is the first time in the opening credits the usual phrase "The Truth is Out There" was changed; it references Deep Throat's last words.

title: Anasazi
source_sentence: The tagline for this episode is ''Éí 'Aaníígóó 'Áhoot'é,'' which means "The Truth is Out There" in [[Navajo language|Navajo]].
The opening-credits tagline for this episode was switched from the show's usual "The Truth Is Out There" to "Apology is Policy.
